name: SQL Dojo
description: Practice the LeetCode SQL 50 inside DBX with a real PostgreSQL 18.6 engine (PGlite 0.5.13) running locally. No server, no setup, works offline. Per-question hints and result-set based grading.

versions.releaseNotes: 0.3.2: the bundled engine is PostgreSQL 18.6 (PGlite 0.5.13), not 16 — the workbench now shows the version the engine reports. Progress is stored through the host plugin storage (host.storage) instead of localStorage, which throws in the sandbox's opaque origin, with a visible session-only fallback. The package now ships LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (PGlite Apache-2.0, PostgreSQL License, MIT question bank); engines.dbx is 0.6.19, the first host release with host.storage. A WebAssembly preflight explains in Chinese when the host sandbox blocks wasm. Local-only: no connection, no network.

zh-CN.name: SQL 练习场
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 里刷力扣 SQL 50 题。内置真正的 PostgreSQL 18.6 引擎（PGlite 0.5.13），离线可用、无需配置数据库。每题带考察点标签和思路提示，按结果集判题。
